stages.title: Initialization identity, runtime, and auxiliary neutralization
stages.mature_baseline: V1.5 initialization owner plus controlled read-only COM closeout
stages.live_boundary: Read-only COM can collect SN/GETCO/runtime evidence with explicit authorization; SN/device_code and S5/S6/S7/S8/S9 writes remain separate controlled actions.
stages.production_rule: Do not enter CO2/H2O routes until SN/device_code, protocol ID, GETCO1-9, S5-S8, and S9 are closed.
stages.next_gap: Package the per-batch initialization closeout into the pre-gas evidence index automatically.

stages.title: Pressure and SENCO9 readiness
stages.mature_baseline: PACE INL absolute pressure and V1.5 pressure/S9 review path
stages.live_boundary: Pressure control is allowed only in the pressure stage; SENCO9 write/readback/reverify remains controlled.
stages.production_rule: Use PACE INL absolute pressure. Do not let CO2/H2O fitting absorb pressure error.
stages.next_gap: Keep offset-only default and linear S9 exceptions explicitly tagged with readback and pressure-only reverify.

stages.title: Route physical readiness and recovery evidence
stages.live_boundary: The recovery binder consumes reviewed traces only; it does not collect dewpoint, vent, pressure, or route data.
stages.production_rule: Route recovery evidence can unblock a fresh run, but diagnostic/smoke data cannot become formal fit data.
stages.next_gap: For future continuous runs, gather live physical recovery evidence through reviewed mature-path smoke, then bind it offline.

stages.title: CO2 mature open-flow route
stages.live_boundary: Uses mature queue/worker only; do not use root migration or 0624 route kernel.
stages.production_rule: Legacy analyzers run CO2 45 points. Single-analyzer ratio instability downgrades that analyzer/point; public physical gates block the point.
stages.next_gap: Add a pre-run continuity guard that refuses segmented carry-over as a formal continuous run.

stages.title: H2O mature open-flow route
stages.live_boundary: Uses mature water-route queue/worker only; do not use 0624 handoff queues as the mature baseline.
stages.production_rule: Legacy analyzers run H2O 13 wet points; new algorithm 14-point plans stay profile/dry-run until reviewed live wiring.
stages.next_gap: Require run manifests before declaring a water route segment formal; empty queue attempts remain rejected diagnostics.

stages.title: No-write fitting strategy review
stages.live_boundary: No coefficient write is implied by a fit candidate.
stages.production_rule: Use physical fit roles, current GETCO state, dry/low-water anchors with dewpoint/pressure evidence, and explicit reject/supersede reasoning.
stages.next_gap: Codify the 0613 multi-strategy fit review into one canonical no-write strategy matrix for CO2 and H2O.

stages.title: Controlled coefficient write and readback
stages.mature_baseline: V1.5 controlled SENCO write tools with live GETCO snapshots
stages.live_boundary: Writes require explicit authorization, old-value snapshot, write, GETCO readback, and rollback/reverify plan.
stages.production_rule: S5/S6 are final linear layers; S5 composition must use current GETCO5 and clear-before-write where required.
stages.next_gap: Unify per-coefficient write summaries into one post-fit write package without hiding per-device exceptions.

stages.title: Post-write short reverification
stages.live_boundary: Reverify samples are collected by reviewed mature route/reverify commands; exporter only reviews evidence.
stages.production_rule: Write success and validation success must be reported separately.
stages.next_gap: Bind short reverify points to the exact coefficient write package and reject stale reverify evidence.

stages.title: Archive, reports, and PostgreSQL 18 import gate
stages.mature_baseline: V1.5 archive closure plus PostgreSQL 18 dry-run/import lock chain
stages.live_boundary: Archive/report is offline; PostgreSQL import remains blocked unless the controlled import chain is explicitly completed.
stages.production_rule: SN/device_code traceability, readback, reverify, archive release, and DB dry-run must all pass before import.
stages.next_gap: Implement real PostgreSQL import only after archive release and controlled executor review are complete.

checks.requirement: Mature gas/water execution baseline is 0613 fitting plus 0620/0621 clean-worktree route behavior.
checks.evidence_rule: Do not treat root migration, 0624, or segmented diagnostics as the formal mature baseline.

checks.requirement: Formal automation plans must not reference _handoff, root migration, 0624, diagnostic, worker, V1, or V2 surfaces.
checks.evidence_rule: Use production entrypoint gate before starting or accepting a formal plan.

checks.requirement: This package must not edit mature route queue/worker, runner, analyzer protocol, default config, or app entry.
checks.evidence_rule: Protected files remain review hotspots and must stay unchanged in this automation-map package.

checks.requirement: Legacy remains CO2 45 and H2O 13; new algorithm 47/14 remains profile/dry-run unless separately live-reviewed.
checks.evidence_rule: New-algorithm runlists must not contaminate legacy mature queues.

checks.requirement: Fit review is no-write; controlled write requires live old-value snapshot, write, readback, and short reverify.
checks.evidence_rule: Do not use no-write math or diagnostic smoke data as release evidence.

checks.requirement: Current V1.5 is structurally organized but still not one-click full production automation.
checks.evidence_rule: Every stage with blocks_full_auto=true remains a deliberate handoff/authorization/review point.

checks.requirement: PostgreSQL 18 import remains after archive/release and controlled import gates.
checks.evidence_rule: No database import is allowed from route, fit, smoke, or no-write evidence alone.
